text:
Jules: Quick non-work poll: what's the strangest "just-in-case" thing you stash around? I found a tiny spare shoelace in my desk and now I feel like I'm in a survival show.
Priya: A folded paper straw. Yes, really. For when cafes give plastic and I can't. :recycle:
Marco: A mini bottle of hot sauce taped under my keyboard drawer. For boring lunches.
Tess: I keep an old concert wristband. Not useful, but morale boost.
Jules: @Marco would you share the brand? emergency hot sauce is a strong choice.
Marco: @Jules it's tiny, brand unknown, came with a takeout order ages ago. Still potent.
Priya: infra-bot: what does the officetips guide recommend for desk emergency items?
infra-bot: infra-bot: Recommended desk kit: phone charger, bandaids, pen, spare mask, and a small multitool. Avoid food items that attract ants.
Tess: A multitool is underrated. Also a tiny packet of hand sanitizer.
Jules: I vote multitool + hot sauce + paper straw squad.
Priya: Vote: multitool, hot sauce, concert wristband, or paper straw? React with :one:/:two:/:three:/:four:.
Marco: :two: hot sauce
Tess: :one: multitool
Priya: :four: paper straw (eco points)
Jules: :one: multitool for sure
infra-bot: infra-bot: Tally so far — multitool leads.
Tess: Okay this is officially my new team ritual: every new hire gets a paper straw.
Jules: Thanks y'all. Bringing my tiny shoelace to the snack table later for show-and-tell.
